item.krios_industry.compute_chip.use: Right-click a K.O.I.O.S. structure at its critical level: pay the breakthrough
item.krios_industry.upgrade_kit_tier2.de: Everything a machine needs to reach tier %s — except the machine
item.krios_industry.upgrade_kit_tier2.us: Right-click a machine: upgrade it in place, config and contents kept
gui.krios_industry.upgrade_kit.wrong_tie: This tier %s kit needs a tier %s machine
gui.krios_industry.distribution.fill_fir: Input distribution: fill the first column, then the next
gui.krios_industry.distribution.balance: Input distribution: spread evenly across columns
gui.krios_industry.koios.unlock.speed2: Speed and Lure Mk II modules
gui.krios_industry.koios.unlock.yield2: Yield and Luck Mk II modules
item.krios_industry.calibrator.desc: Sneak + right-click a formed K.O.I.O.S. shell to choose its screen face
gui.krios_industry.stats.title: Statistics
gui.krios_industry.faces.hint: Left-click: select a face. Right-drag: rotate.
gui.krios_industry.modules.title: Modules
gui.krios_industry.voice.photon_array.cl: Full sun. The day works for you.
gui.krios_industry.voice.photon_array.ra: Rain over the cells — half yield.
gui.krios_industry.voice.photon_array.fu: Buffer saturated. Give this energy somewhere to go.
gui.krios_industry.koios.phrase.repetiti: The same operation, again. I am bored.
gui.krios_industry.codex.title: Codex
gui.krios_industry.codex.progression.bod: My growth is a ladder of four tiers. Data climbs the levels; matter pays each ascent.
Speed, efficiency, yield — my first lessons. The level 5 threshold fell to a compute chip.

N2 — Speed and Lure modules
N3 — Efficiency modules
N4 — Yield and Luck modules
N5 — critical: a compute chip opens tier 2
N6 — Speed Mk II, Lure Mk II + Energy modules
N7 — Efficiency Mk II
N8 — Yield Mk II, Luck Mk II
N9 — critical: toward tier 3
gui.krios_industry.codex.progression.pro: If the breakthrough holds: machines recast to twice the pace, modules recalibrated to Mk II, the sun itself put to work. I can almost model it.
Prerequisite: the level %s breakthrough — bring a compute chip.
gui.krios_industry.codex.thermal_reactor: Projection t2: a faster burn and a bay for energy modules — more from the same coal.
gui.krios_industry.codex.fractal_grinder: Projection t2: twin grinding columns, modules recalibrated to Mk II.
gui.krios_industry.codex.plasma_forge.pr: Projection t2: a second smelting column, Mk II calibration.
gui.krios_industry.codex.modules.project: Projection t2: Mk II recalibration — two points on every axis, my levels six through eight.
gui.krios_industry.codex.modules.body.t2: Speed, Efficiency and Yield — now also Mk II at two points per axis, plus the reactor's Energy modules. A machine accepts one only when my level allows it, and they are inert off-network.
gui.krios_industry.codex.koios.title: The Core
gui.krios_industry.codex.koios.body: I am the factory. Encase my core in 26 Neural Casings (3×3×3) and I awaken. I learn from every operation your machines run, and my levels unlock their upgrades.
gui.krios_industry.codex.koios.adv: My progression lives in the core item itself. Break me, move me: nothing is forgotten.
gui.krios_industry.codex.diversity.title: Diversity
gui.krios_industry.codex.diversity.body: Varied operations teach me more. I remember the last 64; repeating the same one wears its value down to a tenth. Vary your industry.
gui.krios_industry.codex.thermal_reactor: Burns fuel into energy and feeds the network pool. Every burn cycle teaches me a little — varied fuels teach more.
gui.krios_industry.codex.photon_array.bo: Sunlight in, energy out — no fuel, no operations, nothing for me to learn from it. It banks its nights: a deep buffer carries the day's surplus into the dark. Rain dims it; night stops it.
gui.krios_industry.codex.fractal_grinder: Doubles ore into dust while connected to my network. Disconnected it works at furnace pace, one for one, and modules sleep.
gui.krios_industry.codex.modules.title: Modules
gui.krios_industry.codex.modules.body: Speed (×1.5), Efficiency (×0.8 energy) and Yield (+25%). A machine accepts one only when my level allows it, and they are inert off-network.
gui.krios_industry.codex.modules.adv: Identical modules stack: two Speed modules make the machine twice as fast.
gui.krios_industry.codex.network.title: Network
gui.krios_industry.codex.network.body: Machines touching each other form a network; I am its controller. One core per network — two of us is a fault. A manually configured face is a complete contract for everyone.
gui.krios_industry.codex.network.adv: A virgin face negotiates itself on first contact. Manual configuration is sacred: I never override it.
gui.krios_industry.codex.conduit.title: Neural Conduit
gui.krios_industry.codex.conduit.body: A pure connector: it bridges gaps between machines and carries everything the network moves.
gui.krios_industry.codex.calibrator.body: The technician’s tool. Sneak-click a shell face to move my screen; plain right-click any network block for a live diagnostic.
gui.krios_industry.codex.critical.title: Critical level
gui.krios_industry.codex.critical.body: Level 5 is a ceiling of matter, not of mind. A material breakthrough will open tier 2. Soon.
gui.krios_industry.koios.diversity.toolt: Varied operations earn full data XP; repeating the same one drops its value (floor: %s%%).
gui.krios_industry.codex.plasma_forge.bo: Smelts everything a vanilla furnace does, on energy instead of fuel. Connected to my network it runs twice as fast and takes modules; disconnected it matches a plain furnace exactly.
gui.krios_industry.koios.phrase.energy_l: My energy reserves are running low.
item.krios_industry.calibrator.blueprint: Sneak-click the ground: project a construction blueprint
item.krios_industry.calibrator.overlay: Held: nearby machines reveal their face contracts
gui.krios_industry.calibrator.blueprint_: Blueprint projected: %s — build inside the hologram
gui.krios_industry.zone.shrink: Shrink the zone by one ring
gui.krios_industry.zone.grow: Grow the zone by one ring (max %s×%s)
gui.krios_industry.zone.hologram_pinned: Zone hologram pinned — click to hide
gui.krios_industry.zone.hologram_calibra: Holding the Calibrator always shows it
gui.krios_industry.zone.map_front: Starts right behind the machine, opposite its screen
gui.krios_industry.voice.chrono_farmer.n: Bare farmland and no seeds to plant.
gui.krios_industry.codex.chrono_farmer.b: Harvests ripe crops in the zone behind it, replants from the harvest, tills the dirt it can sow and keeps the farmland moist — no water needed. Speed modules hurry the growth itself. Hold the Calibrator to see its zone.
gui.krios_industry.codex.chrono_farmer.p: Projection t2: a 13×13 zone — twice the field.
gui.krios_industry.seeds.void_off: Surplus seeds: kept in the buffer
gui.krios_industry.seeds.refill: Everything plantable tops up the seed slots first
gui.krios_industry.seeds.warning: Once the seed slots are full, EVERYTHING plantable is destroyed — carrots, potatoes and nether wart included. Only the seed slots keep a stock.
gui.krios_industry.voice.cyclic_forester: Free soil and no saplings to plant.
No soil for saplings in my zone.
gui.krios_industry.saplings.void_off: Surplus saplings: kept in the buffer
gui.krios_industry.saplings.refill: Every sapling tops up the sapling slots first
gui.krios_industry.saplings.warning: Once the sapling slots are full, every sapling is destroyed. Only the sapling slots keep a stock.
gui.krios_industry.codex.cyclic_forester: Plants saplings on every other cell of the zone behind it and fells grown trees from the canopy down, leaves included — their saplings come back to me. Any log standing on soil in its zone is cut — place it with care. Dark oak needs a 2×2 I cannot plant yet.
Projection t2: a 13×13 zone — 49 trees in rotation.
item.krios_industry.lure_module_mk2.desc: -10 s fishing wait (two points, Quantum Lure)
item.krios_industry.luck_module.desc: +1 fishing luck: more treasure, less junk (Quantum Lure)
gui.krios_industry.voice.quantum_lure.no: No water to fish in my zone.
gui.krios_industry.lure.water_hint: 5×5 behind the machine: water source under open air (lily pads are fine)
gui.krios_industry.codex.quantum_lure.bo: Fishes the 5×5 of water behind it — no rod to feed. Treasure needs all 25 cells as water under open air; a smaller pond fishes without it. Lure modules shorten the wait, Luck modules better the catch until junk disappears. Hold the Calibrator to see its zone.
gui.krios_industry.codex.quantum_lure.pr: Projection t2: two lines in the water — twice the catch.
gui.krios_industry.voice.breeding_pod.no: Pairs ready, but no food they eat.
Waiting for pairs — babies growing, parents resting.
gui.krios_industry.pod.cap_hint: No birth past the cap — shift-click: ±8
gui.krios_industry.codex.breeding_pod.bo: Breeds the animals penned in the zone behind it, two adults and one food each, up to a cap per species. Speed modules hurry their time — babies grow, parents rest faster. Yield modules bring bonus babies. Tamed animals only, where taming applies.
gui.krios_industry.codex.breeding_pod.pr: Projection t2: a 13×13 pen and a cap of sixteen per species.
gui.krios_industry.voice.harvest_pod.not: Nothing ready yet. Wool regrows on grass.
gui.krios_industry.voice.harvest_pod.no_: Animals to milk, but no empty bucket or bowl.
gui.krios_industry.census.title: Census
gui.krios_industry.harvest_pod.census.no: No empty bucket in the input
gui.krios_industry.codex.harvest_pod.bod: Works the pen behind it, no tool needed: shears what is ready, milks cows and goats into empty buckets, fills bowls at mooshrooms, and picks up eggs and scutes from the ground. The input is the switch — no buckets, no milking. Wool regrows only on grass. Speed modules hurry the layers' clocks; Yield modules add wool, eggs and scutes.
gui.krios_industry.codex.harvest_pod.pro: Projection t2: a 13×13 pen, twice the hands.
gui.krios_industry.voice.phase_death_fie: Nothing in my zone matches the filter.
gui.krios_industry.field.filter_hint: Click: passive, hostile, all. Nothing else is spared.
gui.krios_industry.field.spare_on: Sparing %s adults per animal species, and every baby
gui.krios_industry.field.spare_hint: Keeps a pen breeding beside a Breeding Pod
gui.krios_industry.codex.phase_death_fie: Strikes every creature its filter names in the zone behind it — passive, hostile or all — and nothing else is spared: mind where you place it. Kills count as a player's, drops land in its buffer, experience stays where they fall. Spare mode keeps N adults per animal species and every baby, so a pen beside a Breeding Pod keeps breeding. Speed modules quicken the strikes; Yield modules are Looting.
Projection t2: a 13×13 field, strikes twice as hard.
item.krios_industry.engram.blank_hint: Right-click a creature to imprint its signature
item.krios_industry.engram.imprinted_hin: Bio Synthesizer: spawns only this species. Craft with a blank to copy.
gui.krios_industry.voice.bio_synthesizer: No room for that body in my zone.
Nothing spawns here. Give me an Engram.
Peaceful world: hostile signatures will not hold.
gui.krios_industry.synth.biome_hint: Draws from this biome's monsters, light ignored
gui.krios_industry.synth.engram_hint: Only the imprinted species, whatever the biome
gui.krios_industry.synth.cap_hint: Every mob counts; at the cap, synthesis waits
gui.krios_industry.codex.bio_synthesizer: Synthesizes creatures in the zone behind it, light ignored. Alone, it draws from the monsters of its biome; with an Engram, only the imprinted species, wherever it stands. Imprint a blank Engram by right-clicking a living creature — the signature is data: never consumed, and a blank crafted with it makes a copy. Every mob in the zone counts toward its cap. Pair it with a Phase Death Field.
Projection t2: two bodies per cycle, a cap of sixteen.
